before.title: Chhena poda
before.summary: Finish with chhena poda, a baked cheese sweet. Ask locally where it is freshly made; we have not yet reviewed a Konark sweet shop.
before.access: Confirm local access, transport and availability before travel.

article.title: Chhena Poda
article.lead: A dark, fragrant edge. A soft centre. Leave a little room at the end of the meal.

before.title: Mudhi Mansa in Baripada
before.summary: Puffed rice and meat curry make Baripada’s well-known Mudhi Mansa pairing.
before.access: Ask about the meat, spice level and current price. Vegetarian travellers can ask the same kitchen what it can prepare separately.

sources.title: Sangram Keshari Senapati · Mudhi Mansa photograph

article.title: Mudhi Mansa
article.lead: The lightness of puffed rice meets the depth of a curry. A meal can be a reason to give a town more time.

before.title: A coastal meal in Chandipur
before.summary: Odisha Tourism highlights crab and prawns at local restaurants.
before.access: Ask what is available, how it is prepared and the price before ordering. Discuss shellfish allergies; ask for a vegetarian alternative if preferred.

article.title: A meal by Chandipur
article.lead: Leave the shoreline with an appetite. Let the kitchen tell you what is good today.

before.title: Make room for dalma
before.summary: Lentils and vegetables meet in dalma, a familiar part of Odisha’s food repertoire.
before.access: Ask what is in today’s preparation and pair it with the rest of a local meal. This is a dish suggestion, not a reviewed restaurant.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · The taste of Odisha
Kitchen Script · Odia Habisa Dalma (7 January 2020)
Chef TZac: Odia cuisine is an evolved cuisine

article.title: Dalma
article.lead: A ladle, a few vegetables, a reason to linger. Let a bowl of dalma introduce you to an Odia table, one ingredient and one conversation at a time.

before.title: Aloo Dum Dahibara
before.summary: Soft lentil fritters in yogurt, served with spicy potato curry. Ask how the cook makes their version.
before.access: Ask about ingredients, spice and preparation. Choose a freshly prepared serving that suits your dietary needs; we have not inspected vendors.

sources.title: Rohit Srivastava · Personal Dahibara Aloodum favourites (26 May 2020)

article.title: Dahibara Aloodum
article.lead: Softness, spice and a spoonful that changes as you mix it. Pause in Cuttack for a bowl with more than one texture—and a story worth asking the person who serves it.

before.title: Machha besara
before.summary: Fish in mustard gravy: a regional dish to seek out along the Puri coast. Ask what fish is being served and how the kitchen prepares it.
before.access: Confirm local access, transport and availability before travel.

sources.title: Chef Nisar Ahmed · Chuna Macha Besara (2 June 2021)

article.title: Machha Besara
article.lead: Follow the mustard before you follow the map. A fish dish opens a conversation about the water it came from, the kitchen that cooked it and the coast you are visiting.
